name: BPTP Verti Greens
summary: Project (BPTP Amstoria Verti Greens), Sector 102 Dwarka Expressway location, RERA number GGM/910/642/2025/13, under-construction status, June 2032 possession, 9.43 acres and 5 towers / 885 units are confirmed by at least one portal each, though other portals give 12 acres, 1,149 units and earlier possession dates. Our starting price of Rs 2.5 Cr is not within ±15% of any source (NoBroker Rs 2.11 Cr, Square Yards/Inframantra ~Rs 3.05 Cr), and our unit sizes (908 / 1,270 sq ft) were not found anywhere (NoBroker carpet: 1,021 / 1,622 sq ft).

checks.web: BPTP Amstoria Verti Greens, Sector 102, Gurugram
checks.note: Portals use the full name 'Amstoria Verti Greens'.
Developer is correct but listed under the project name rather than 'BPTP Limited'.

checks.ours: Sector 102, Dwarka Expressway, Sector 102, Gurugram, Haryana

checks.note: Same number, but ours lacks the 'RC/REP/' prefix and contains a stray space after 'GGM/'. Inframantra additionally shows RERA-GRG-1830-2024 (the HARERA application id).
Sources disagree; June 2032 is the most frequently cited date and likely the RERA date.

checks.web: Rs 2.11 Cr (NoBroker); Rs 3.05 Cr (Square Yards); Rs 3.06 Cr (Inframantra); Rs 3.50 Cr for 2 BHK (Propzilla)
checks.note: No source is within ±15% of Rs 2.5 Cr: NoBroker is ~16% lower, while most portals are ~22%+ higher (~Rs 3.05 Cr). Sources bracket our value, so severity set to medium; current market entry appears closer to Rs 3 Cr.
